scope: Synthetic temporary-payload safety regression only; no server or real experiment data deleted
limitations: The reported historic 800 GB is total usage, not a measured reclaimable amount.
Hardlink dedup is optional and limited to immutable historical run copies; it is not copy-on-write and root can bypass read-only permissions.
Unknown scratch layouts are inventoried but not automatically removed without completion evidence.
Permanent raw-payload deletion can require rerunning VPR for new spatial analyses.
